hooks.text: 从荒地白手建设聚落，并随进度逐步解锁新建筑和作战单位，把边疆发展成城镇
hooks.excerpt: Transform barren lands into bustling settlements! Start with basic structures and gradually unlock new buildings and units as you progress.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从两百多张卡牌中构筑城建牌组，出牌时机直接影响应对危机和建设效率
hooks.excerpt: Choose from over 200 unique cards to construct your perfect deck. Use your cards with skill and timing to overcome challenges and build your town efficiently.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每个月末敌军都会进攻亲手建成的城镇，必须提前加固防线应对逐月增强的波次
hooks.excerpt: At the end of each month, enemies will attempt to destroy the town you so carefully built! Fortify your defenses and repel increasingly powerful waves of attackers!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 视觉表现比同类参考更有吸引力。

excerpts.excerpt: I found this more fun and visually compelling.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 自然阵营明显强于王国阵营

excerpts.excerpt: 自然比王国强太多了很多强牌还是通用的，卡牌太少了
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 每轮反复做同一件事，变化很少

excerpts.excerpt: you will be doing the same thing every single round with very little to no variation.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 不过这个游戏到后面几关流程就比较固定了
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 地图未在开局完全揭示，中途才告知另一侧也会出怪

excerpts.excerpt: 一开始开图不开全，打到一半开图告诉你另一边也出怪
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 友军AI经常做出送死行为
挑战类型多样，为战斗增加思考和动态变化。

excerpts.excerpt: a nice variety of challenges which add an intellectual component and help with dynamic battles.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 用城墙改变怪物路线是较有策略性的环节

excerpts.excerpt: 比较有策略的应该是用城墙来改变怪物的前进路线
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
